goal: Allow test networks with -acceptnonstdtxn=1 to accept non-mandatory script check failures into the mempool
Let developers test prospective soft forks using opcodes like OP_SUCCESS without mining directly into blocks
agreement: Broad support from reviewers, with multiple ACKs across design iterations
Verified by rebasing bip448 branch and testing compile and runtime flag enforcement (instagibbs)
Contested objection: alters -acceptnonstdtxn beyond Knots behavior where upgradable opcodes stay off (luke-jr)
Open suggestions remain for minor logging, release note wording, and additional test coverage

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it adds developer tooling for testing soft forks and experimental transactions on test networks
Confined to testnets running non-default mempool policy rather than affecting mainnet validation
